content.text: The upstream project uses `/confirm-new-email` for this link.

candidates.explanation: The confirm-new-email mail builds its link from the frontend domain plus '/confirm-email'. That is the same path userSignUp uses for sign-up activation. The frontend page at that path calls the sign-up endpoint POST /auth/email/confirm (AuthService.confirmEmail). The new-email hash is meant for POST /auth/email/confirm/new (AuthService.confirmNewEmail), so the email change is never completed. The link should point to the dedicated '/confirm-new-email' page.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email', so the frontend can call the /auth/email/confirm/new endpoint.
